title: A Phase 1, Open-Label Study to Assess the Single-Dose Pharmacokinetics of Eravacycline in Subjects With End Stage Renal Disease and Healthy Subjects
brief_summary: This is a multi-center, open-label clinical study to assess the single-dose PK of eravacycline in subjects with renal impairment and healthy subjects conducted at approximately 2 sites in the United States. This study includes an up to 21-day Screening Period, a 5-day Treatment Period, and an End of Study Visit occurring approximately 2 weeks (±2 days) after study drug administration. Approximately 12 subjects will be enrolled: 6 subjects with ESRD and 6 healthy subjects with normal renal function. Healthy subjects will be matched to renally impaired subjects in gender, age, and body mass index (BMI). All subjects will be administered a single IV dose of eravacycline (1.5 mg/kg).
